name: innernet
description: one versioned memory for your projects and for you, read and written over MCP.

interface.shortDescription: one memory for every AI tool
interface.longDescription:
innernet keeps one versioned memory of your projects and of you, so a conversation can start from what you already decided instead of from zero.

connect your innernet account and this assistant can read your projects: what you are building, what you decided and why, and what is in motion. when work produces a decision, innernet saves it back to the project with a commit history you can walk and edit.

what it does here:

- loads a project's context map: its vision, roadmap, decisions and state.
- answers from the sections that bear on the question, and leaves out sections you already have in this conversation.
- shows your map in an interactive view: browse dimensions and read them in place.
- keeps each project's task list: see, add and complete tasks in the conversation.
- carries a personal memory (preferences, how you work) across projects, with disclosure levels you set in innernet.
- finds skills on innernet's public community, loads one into this conversation, or keeps a private copy. when you explicitly ask, it can publish or withdraw a skill with its author, licence and source attached.

the same memory is available to any MCP client you connect.

an innernet.live account is required. the plugin reads and writes data in your connected account; nothing is published publicly unless you ask.
